source.text: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים חָמֵשׁ֩ אַמּ֨וֹת אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְחָֽמֵשׁ־אַמּ֤וֹת רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֔וּעַ וְשָׁלֹ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת קֹמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made the altar of the burnt offering [of] woods of acacia; five cubits its length and five cubits its breadth, square, and three cubits its height.

en.L: And he made the altar of burnt offering [of] acacia wood, 5 cubits its length and 5 cubits its breadth, square, and 3 cubits its height.
en.B: He made the altar of burnt offering out of acacia wood. It was square, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} on each side and {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|3 cubits}} high.
en.R: Bezalel made the altar for burnt offerings out of acacia wood. It was square, {{units:about 7 1/2 feet|5 cubits}} on each side and {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|3 cubits}} tall.

es.L: E hizo el altar del holocausto [de] madera de acacia; cinco codos su longitud y cinco codos su anchura, cuadrado, y tres codos su altura.
es.B: Hizo el altar del holocausto de madera de acacia. Era cuadrado, de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} por lado y {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}} de alto.
es.R: Bezalel hizo de madera de acacia el altar para los holocaustos. Era cuadrado, de {{units:unos 2,25 metros|cinco codos}} por cada lado y {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}} de alto.

fr.L: Et il fit l’autel de l’holocauste [de] bois d’acacia, cinq coudées sa longueur et cinq coudées sa largeur, carré, et trois coudées sa hauteur.
fr.B: Il fit l’autel de l’holocauste en bois d’acacia. Il était carré, de {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de côté et de {{units:environ 1,35 mètre|trois coudées}} de haut.
fr.R: Betsaleel a fait en bois d’acacia l’autel pour les holocaustes. Il était carré, avec {{units:environ 2,25 mètres|cinq coudées}} de chaque côté et {{units:environ 1,35 mètre|trois coudées}} de haut.

sw.L: Akaifanya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa [kwa] mbao za mshita, dhiraa tano urefu wake na dhiraa tano upana wake, mraba, na dhiraa tatu kimo chake.
sw.B: Akaitengeneza madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa mbao za mshita. Ilikuwa mraba, {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}} kila upande, na kimo cha {{units:karibu mita 1.35|dhiraa tatu}}.
sw.R: Bezaleli alitengeneza madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa kwa mbao za mshita. Ilikuwa mraba, {{units:karibu mita 2.25|dhiraa tano}} kila upande, na kimo chake {{units:karibu mita 1.35|dhiraa tatu}}.

vi.L: Và ông làm bàn thờ của lễ thiêu [bằng] gỗ keo, chiều dài năm cu-đê và chiều rộng năm cu-đê, vuông, và chiều cao ba cu-đê.
vi.B: Ông làm bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu bằng gỗ keo. Bàn thờ hình vuông, mỗi cạnh {{units:khoảng 2,25 m|năm cu-đê}}, cao {{units:khoảng 1,35 m|ba cu-đê}}.
vi.R: Bết-sa-lê-ên làm bàn thờ để dâng của lễ thiêu bằng gỗ keo. Bàn thờ hình vuông, mỗi cạnh dài {{units:khoảng 2,25 m|năm cu-đê}} và cao {{units:khoảng 1,35 m|ba cu-đê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 번제의 제단을 아카시아 나무로 만들었다. 그 길이가 다섯 규빗, 그 너비가 다섯 규빗으로 정사각형이었고, 그 높이는 세 규빗이었다.
ko.B: 그는 아카시아 나무로 번제단을 만들었다. 제단은 정사각형으로, 가로세로가 {{units:약 2.25미터|다섯 규빗}}이고 높이는 {{units:약 1.35미터|세 규빗}}이었다.
ko.R: 브살렐은 아카시아 나무로 번제를 드릴 제단을 만들었다. 제단은 네모반듯해서 가로와 세로가 {{units:약 2.25미터|다섯 규빗}}씩이고, 높이는 {{units:약 1.35미터|세 규빗}}이었다.

pt.L: E fez o altar do holocausto [de] madeira de acácia; cinco côvados o seu comprimento e cinco côvados a sua largura, quadrado, e três côvados a sua altura.
pt.B: Ele fez o altar dos holocaustos de madeira de acácia. O altar era quadrado, com {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de cada lado e {{units:cerca de 1,35 metro|três côvados}} de altura.
pt.R: Bezalel fez o altar para os holocaustos com madeira de acácia. O altar era quadrado, com {{units:cerca de 2,25 metros|cinco côvados}} de cada lado e {{units:cerca de 1,35 metro|três côvados}} de altura.

am.L: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት መሠዊያ ከግራር እንጨት ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱ አምስት ክንድ፣ ወርዱም አምስት ክንድ፣ አራት ማዕዘን፣ ቁመቱም ሦስት ክንድ [ነበረ]።
am.B: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት መሠዊያውን ከግራር እንጨት ሠራ። ጎኖቹ እኩል የሆኑ አራት ማዕዘን ነበረ፤ እያንዳንዱ ጎኑ {{units:2.25 ሜትር ያህል|አምስት ክንድ}}፣ ቁመቱም {{units:1.35 ሜትር ያህል|ሦስት ክንድ}} ነበረ።
am.R: ባስልኤል የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚቀርብበትን መሠዊያ ከግራር እንጨት ሠራ። ጎኖቹ እኩል የሆኑ አራት ማዕዘን ነበረ፤ እያንዳንዱ ጎን {{units:2.25 ሜትር ያህል|አምስት ክንድ}}፣ ቁመቱም {{units:1.35 ሜትር ያህል|ሦስት ክንድ}} ነበረ።

decisions.choice: he made: Bezalel made
decisions.reason: The one who makes the furnishings in chapters 37-38 is Bezalel, named at 37:1 and again in verse 22.

decisions.choice: the altar of burnt offering: made as commanded in 27:1-8
decisions.reason: Verses 1-7 tell how the bronze altar was made, following the instructions of 27:1-8 almost word for word. The notes on those verses explain its parts; the notes here point back to them.

decisions.choice: cubit: a measure of length, from the elbow to the tip of the fingers, about 18 inches
decisions.reason: The cubit was the length of a forearm, about 18 inches (about 45 centimeters). The altar was about 7 1/2 feet square and about 4 1/2 feet high (27:1).

decisions.choice: modern measure first, cubits as the alternative
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the size of the altar in feet by default, with the cubits of the Hebrew as the units alternative. Literal keeps cubits, written as numerals like every measurement.

decisions.choice: Bezalel
decisions.reason: Readable names Bezalel for "he" (m1), since the chapter opens without naming him. Literal and Balanced keep "he".

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("fit", "plaqua", "fondit"); passé composé at Readable ("a fait", "a recouvert", "a utilisé")
decisions.reason: As in chapter 37 and the other narrative chapters of Exodus (docs/french-style.md, section 3): the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the tense of spoken French.

decisions.choice: metric first: "약 2.25미터", "약 1.35미터"; cubits ("규빗") as the alternative
decisions.reason: Korean readers measure in metres, so the units setting gives metres by default (cubit 45 cm) and the original cubit as the alternative, as in Korean Kings and Chronicles; the English gives US units instead. Literal keeps cubits. This holds for every measure and weight in chapters 38-40 (talent 34 kg, shekel 11.5 g, beka 5.7 g, span 23 cm).

decisions.choice: "아카시아 나무" for acacia wood
decisions.reason: The tree is the acacia, and "아카시아" is the word Korean readers know; "조각목" and "싯딤 나무" are older Bible words that hide what the wood was. Used throughout the tabernacle chapters.

decisions.choice: metric first ("khoảng 2,25 m"), with the cubit ("năm cu-đê") as the units alternative; Literal keeps "cu-đê"
alternatives: US units as in the English
decisions.reason: As the Genesis terms note and the Vietnamese style guide: Vietnamese readers measure in metres, so the default is metric (cubit 45 cm), written with a decimal comma; the setting gives the original unit. Recorded once for these chapters.

decisions.choice: "gỗ keo" (acacia wood)
decisions.reason: "gỗ keo" names the tree in plain modern Vietnamese; the older Protestant "gỗ si-tim" only transliterates the Hebrew plural and means nothing to most readers. Used for every acacia-wood item in these chapters.

decisions.choice: the wording of 27:1-8, turned into narrative
decisions.reason: Chapters 38-40 tell how the instructions of chapters 25-31 were carried out, often in the same Hebrew words (m2). Where the Hebrew repeats, Portuguese repeats the wording of the instruction (here 27:1 and 30:28: "o altar do holocausto" (L), "o altar dos holocaustos" (B), "o altar para os holocaustos" (R), the same measures in metric) and only turns God's future "farás" into the narrative past "fez", so that a reader can lay the two passages side by side.

decisions.choice: Metric first in a units span ("2.25 ሜትር ያህል"), the cubit ("ክንድ") as the alternative; Literal keeps "ክንድ"
alternatives: US units as in the English
decisions.reason: The Amharic style guide gives metric measures by default, at 45 cm to the cubit.

decisions.choice: "የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት መሠዊያ" for the altar of burnt offering (Readable "የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚቀርብበት መሠዊያ")
decisions.reason: "የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት" is the terms list's burnt offering; Readable spells out what the altar was for, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ קַרְנֹתָ֗יו עַ֚ל אַרְבַּ֣ע פִּנֹּתָ֔יו מִמֶּ֖נּוּ הָי֣וּ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וַיְצַ֥ף אֹת֖וֹ נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made its horns on its four corners; from it were its horns; and he overlaid it [with] bronze.

en.L: And he made its horns on its four corners; its horns were from it, and he overlaid it [with] bronze.
en.B: He shaped horns on its four corners, forming part of the altar itself, and overlaid it with bronze.
en.R: He made a horn-shaped point sticking up at each of its four corners. The horns were part of the altar itself, not separate pieces. He covered the altar with bronze.

es.L: E hizo sus cuernos sobre sus cuatro esquinas; sus cuernos eran de él [mismo], y lo revistió [de] bronce.
es.B: Formó cuernos en sus cuatro esquinas, que eran parte del mismo altar, y lo revistió de bronce.
es.R: En cada una de sus cuatro esquinas hizo una punta en forma de cuerno que sobresalía hacia arriba. Los cuernos eran parte del mismo altar, no piezas aparte. Cubrió el altar de bronce.

fr.L: Et il fit ses cornes sur ses quatre coins ; ses cornes étaient de lui, et il le plaqua [de] bronze.
fr.B: Il façonna des cornes à ses quatre coins, faisant corps avec l’autel, et il le plaqua de bronze.
fr.R: À chacun de ses quatre coins, il a fait une pointe en forme de corne, dressée vers le haut. Les cornes faisaient partie de l’autel lui-même, ce n’étaient pas des pièces séparées. Il a recouvert l’autel de bronze.

sw.L: Akazifanya pembe zake kwenye kona zake nne; pembe zake zilitokana nayo, akaifunika [kwa] shaba.
sw.B: Akatengeneza pembe kwenye kona zake nne, zikiwa sehemu ya madhabahu yenyewe, akaifunika kwa shaba.
sw.R: Kwenye kila kona yake nne akatengeneza ncha yenye umbo la pembe iliyochomoza juu. Pembe hizo zilikuwa sehemu ya madhabahu yenyewe, si vipande vilivyotengwa. Akaifunika madhabahu kwa shaba.

vi.L: Và ông làm các sừng của nó trên bốn góc của nó; các sừng của nó [liền] từ nó, và ông bọc nó [bằng] đồng.
vi.B: Ông làm các sừng ở bốn góc bàn thờ, liền một khối với bàn thờ, rồi bọc bàn thờ bằng đồng.
vi.R: Ở mỗi góc trong bốn góc bàn thờ, ông làm một cái sừng nhô lên. Các sừng ấy liền một khối với bàn thờ, không phải là những miếng rời. Ông bọc bàn thờ bằng đồng.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 그것의 네 모퉁이 위에 그것의 뿔들을 만들었다. 그것의 뿔들은 그것에서 [나온 것]이었다. 그리고 그는 그것을 놋으로 입혔다.
ko.B: 그는 제단의 네 모퉁이에 뿔을 만들어 제단과 한 덩어리가 되게 하고, 제단을 놋으로 입혔다.
ko.R: 그는 제단의 네 모퉁이마다 뿔처럼 솟은 부분을 만들었다. 그 뿔들은 따로 만들어 붙인 것이 아니라 제단과 한 몸이었다. 그리고 제단 전체를 놋으로 씌웠다.

pt.L: E fez os seus chifres nos seus quatro cantos; dele eram os seus chifres; e o cobriu [de] bronze.
pt.B: Fez chifres nos seus quatro cantos, formando uma só peça com o altar, e o revestiu de bronze.
pt.R: Ele fez uma ponta em forma de chifre, virada para cima, em cada um dos quatro cantos do altar. Esses chifres faziam parte do próprio altar e não eram peças separadas. Ele cobriu o altar de bronze.

am.L: ቀንዶቹንም በአራቱ ማዕዘኖቹ ላይ ሠራ፤ ቀንዶቹ ከእርሱ [የወጡ] ነበሩ፤ በነሐስም ለበጠው።
am.B: በአራቱ ማዕዘኖቹ ላይ ከመሠዊያው ጋር አንድ ወጥ የሆኑ ቀንዶችን ሠራ፤ በነሐስም ለበጠው።
am.R: በአራቱም ማዕዘኖቹ ላይ ወደ ላይ የቆመ የቀንድ ቅርጽ ያለው ጫፍ ሠራ። ቀንዶቹ ለብቻቸው የተሠሩ ሳይሆኑ የመሠዊያው ክፍል ነበሩ። መሠዊያውን በነሐስ ሸፈነው።

decisions.choice: its horns were from it: of one piece with the altar
decisions.reason: As in 27:2, the horns were not made separately and fixed on; they were part of the altar's own frame.

decisions.choice: a horn-shaped point sticking up
decisions.reason: Readable describes the horns and spells out "from it", as at 27:2.

decisions.choice: "놋" for bronze
decisions.reason: "놋" is the word Korean Kings and Chronicles already use for the bronze of the temple (놋기둥, 놋 바다); "청동" is the modern technical term. Kept for all the bronze work of the tabernacle.

decisions.choice: "ነሐስ" for bronze
decisions.reason: "ነሐስ" is the common modern word for bronze and copper; "ናስ" now names brass, a later alloy.

source.text: וַיַּ֜עַשׂ אֶֽת־כָּל־כְּלֵ֣י הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֶת־הַסִּירֹ֤ת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִים֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָקֹ֔ת אֶת־הַמִּזְלָגֹ֖ת וְאֶת־הַמַּחְתֹּ֑ת כָּל־כֵּלָ֖יו עָשָׂ֥ה נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made all the articles of the altar: the pots and the shovels and the basins, the forks and the firepans; all its articles he made [of] bronze.

en.L: And he made all the utensils of the altar: the pots and the shovels and the basins, the forks and the firepans; all its utensils he made [of] bronze.
en.B: He made all the utensils for the altar: the pots, shovels, basins, forks and firepans. He made all its utensils of bronze.
en.R: He made all the tools for the altar out of bronze: the pots, shovels, bowls, forks, and pans for carrying hot coals.

es.L: E hizo todos los utensilios del altar: las ollas, y las palas, y los tazones, los tenedores y los braseros; todos sus utensilios los hizo [de] bronce.
es.B: Hizo todos los utensilios del altar: las ollas, las palas, los tazones, los tenedores y los braseros. Todos sus utensilios los hizo de bronce.
es.R: Hizo de bronce todas las herramientas del altar: las ollas, las palas, los tazones, los tenedores y los recipientes para llevar las brasas.

fr.L: Et il fit tous les ustensiles de l’autel : les marmites, et les pelles, et les bassins, les fourchettes et les récipients à braises ; tous ses ustensiles, il les fit [de] bronze.
fr.B: Il fit tous les ustensiles de l’autel : les marmites, les pelles, les bassins, les fourchettes et les récipients à braises. Il fit tous ses ustensiles en bronze.
fr.R: Il a fait en bronze tous les outils pour l’autel : les marmites, les pelles, les bols, les fourchettes et les plats pour porter les braises.

sw.L: Akafanya vyombo vyote vya madhabahu: vyungu, na mabeleshi, na mabakuli, nyuma na vyetezo; vyombo vyake vyote akavifanya [kwa] shaba.
sw.B: Akatengeneza vyombo vyote vya madhabahu: vyungu, mabeleshi, mabakuli, nyuma na vyetezo. Vyombo vyake vyote alivifanya kwa shaba.
sw.R: Akatengeneza kwa shaba vifaa vyote vya madhabahu: vyungu, mabeleshi, bakuli, nyuma za kushikia nyama, na vyombo vya kubebea makaa ya moto.

vi.L: Và ông làm mọi đồ dùng của bàn thờ: các thùng, các xẻng, các chậu, các nĩa và các lư than; mọi đồ dùng của nó ông làm [bằng] đồng.
vi.B: Ông làm mọi đồ dùng cho bàn thờ: thùng hốt tro, xẻng, chậu, nĩa và lư than. Ông làm mọi đồ dùng ấy bằng đồng.
vi.R: Ông làm bằng đồng tất cả những dụng cụ dùng cho bàn thờ: thùng để hốt tro, xẻng, bát, nĩa và những lư để đựng than hồng.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 제단의 모든 기구, 곧 솥들과 부삽들과 대접들과 고기 갈고리들과 불 그릇들을 만들었다. 그것의 모든 기구를 그는 놋으로 만들었다.
ko.B: 그는 제단에 쓰는 모든 기구, 곧 솥과 부삽과 대접과 고기 갈고리와 불 옮기는 그릇을 만들었다. 제단의 기구는 모두 놋으로 만들었다.
ko.R: 그는 제단에서 쓸 도구를 모두 놋으로 만들었다. 솥과 삽과 그릇과 고기를 집는 갈고리와, 뜨거운 숯불을 담아 나르는 그릇이었다.

pt.L: E fez todos os utensílios do altar: as panelas e as pás e as bacias, os garfos e os braseiros; todos os seus utensílios fez [de] bronze.
pt.B: Fez todos os utensílios do altar: as panelas, as pás, as bacias, os garfos e os braseiros. Todos os seus utensílios ele fez de bronze.
pt.R: Ele fez de bronze todos os utensílios do altar: as panelas, as pás, as bacias, os garfos e as pás para carregar brasas.

am.L: የመሠዊያውንም ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ሠራ፤ ድስቶቹን፣ አካፋዎቹን፣ የመርጫ ሳሕኖቹን፣ ሜንጦዎቹንና የእሳት ማንሻዎቹን፤ ዕቃዎቹን ሁሉ ከነሐስ ሠራ።
am.B: የመሠዊያውን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ሠራ፤ ድስቶቹን፣ አካፋዎቹን፣ የመርጫ ሳሕኖቹን፣ ሜንጦዎቹንና የእሳት ማንሻዎቹን። ዕቃዎቹን ሁሉ ከነሐስ ሠራ።
am.R: የመሠዊያውን መሣሪያዎች ሁሉ ከነሐስ ሠራ፤ ድስቶቹን፣ አካፋዎቹን፣ ሳሕኖቹን፣ ሜንጦዎቹንና ፍም መያዣዎቹን ሠራ።

decisions.choice: the altar's tools, as listed in 27:3
decisions.reason: The list matches 27:3: pots for the fatty ashes, shovels, bowls for the blood of the offerings, forks for the meat and pans for burning coals (see the notes there).

decisions.choice: bowls ... pans for carrying hot coals
decisions.reason: As at 27:3, Readable says "bowls" and explains the firepans. Literal and Balanced keep "basins" and "firepans".

decisions.choice: "mabeleshi" (shovels); "nyuma" (forks), "nyuma za kushikia nyama" (R)
decisions.reason: "Beleshi" is a shovel, the tool for clearing ashes (m1); "jembe" is a hoe. "Nyuma" is the plural of "uma" (fork); Readable says what the forks were for, handling the meat of the offerings.

decisions.choice: "솥, 부삽, 대접, 고기 갈고리, 불 옮기는 그릇" (Literal "불 그릇") for the altar's tools
decisions.reason: The same names Korean 1 Kings 7 and 2 Chronicles 4 give the temple's altar tools, so the two descriptions read alike. Readable says what each was for.

decisions.choice: "thùng" for the pots and "lư than" for the firepans, as in the drafts of Exodus 27:3
decisions.reason: The pots carried away the ashes and the pans carried live coals; "lư than" (coal pan) avoids "lư hương", which would suggest an incense burner.

decisions.choice: "ድስቶች" (pots), "አካፋዎች" (shovels), "የመርጫ ሳሕኖች" (basins, for sprinkling blood), "ሜንጦዎች" (forks), "የእሳት ማንሻዎች" (firepans; Readable "ፍም መያዣዎች")
alternatives: "ጎድጓዳ ሳሕኖች" for the basins (kept for the table's bowls)
decisions.reason: The basins took the blood to be splashed on the altar; the firepans are the same word as at the lampstand (37:23).

source.text: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ לַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ מִכְבָּ֔ר מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה רֶ֣שֶׁת נְחֹ֑שֶׁת תַּ֧חַת כַּרְכֻּבּ֛וֹ מִלְּמַ֖טָּה עַד־חֶצְיֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made for the altar a grating, a work of network [of] bronze, under its ledge, from below up to its middle.

en.L: And he made for the altar a grating, a work of network [of] bronze, under its ledge, from below up to its middle.
en.B: He made for the altar a grating of bronze, worked as a mesh, and set it under its ledge, reaching from below up to the middle of the altar.
en.R: He made a bronze grate shaped like a net for the altar. It was under the ledge that ran around the altar, and it reached halfway up.

es.L: E hizo para el altar un enrejado, obra de red [de] bronce, debajo de su reborde, desde abajo hasta su mitad.
es.B: Hizo para el altar un enrejado de bronce, trabajado como una malla, y lo colocó debajo de su reborde, desde abajo hasta la mitad del altar.
es.R: Hizo para el altar una parrilla de bronce en forma de red. Estaba debajo del reborde que rodeaba el altar, y llegaba hasta la mitad de su altura.

fr.L: Et il fit pour l’autel une grille, un ouvrage en réseau [de] bronze, sous son rebord, depuis le bas jusqu’à son milieu.
fr.B: Il fit pour l’autel une grille de bronze, travaillée en treillis, et la plaça sous son rebord, depuis le bas jusqu’à mi-hauteur de l’autel.
fr.R: Il a fait pour l’autel une grille de bronze en forme de filet. Elle était sous le rebord qui faisait le tour de l’autel, et elle montait jusqu’à mi-hauteur.

sw.L: Akaifanyia madhabahu wavu, kazi ya kusuka, [wa] shaba, chini ya ukingo wake, kutoka chini hadi katikati yake.
sw.B: Akaifanyia madhabahu wavu wa shaba uliotengenezwa kwa kusukwa, akauweka chini ya ukingo wake, kutoka chini hadi katikati ya madhabahu.
sw.R: Akatengeneza wavu wa shaba kwa ajili ya madhabahu. Ulikuwa chini ya ukingo uliozunguka madhabahu, na ulifika nusu ya kimo chake.

vi.L: Và ông làm cho bàn thờ một tấm rá, công việc [kiểu] mạng lưới [bằng] đồng, dưới gờ của nó, từ dưới lên đến giữa nó.
vi.B: Ông làm cho bàn thờ một tấm rá bằng đồng, đan như mạng lưới, đặt bên dưới gờ bàn thờ, từ dưới lên đến nửa chiều cao bàn thờ.
vi.R: Ông làm cho bàn thờ một tấm rá bằng đồng giống như cái lưới. Tấm rá ở dưới cái gờ chạy quanh bàn thờ và lên đến nửa chiều cao của bàn thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 제단을 위하여 석쇠를 만들었는데, 그물 세공으로 된 놋 [석쇠]였고, 그것의 턱 아래에서 아래로부터 그것의 중간까지 [닿았다].
ko.B: 그는 제단에 달 놋 석쇠를 그물처럼 엮어 만들고, 그것을 제단 턱 아래에 달아 밑에서부터 제단 중간 높이까지 닿게 했다.
ko.R: 그는 그물처럼 생긴 놋 석쇠를 만들어 제단에 달았다. 석쇠는 제단을 빙 둘러 있는 턱 아래에 있었고, 제단의 절반 높이까지 올라왔다.

pt.L: E fez para o altar uma grelha, obra de rede [de] bronze, debaixo do seu rebordo, de baixo até o meio dele.
pt.B: Fez para o altar uma grelha de bronze em forma de rede e a pôs debaixo do rebordo, de modo que ela ia de baixo até a metade do altar.
pt.R: Ele fez para o altar uma grelha de bronze em forma de rede. Ela ficava debaixo da beirada que contornava o altar e chegava até a metade da altura dele.

am.L: ለመሠዊያውም ከነሐስ የመረብ ሥራ የሆነ ፍርግርግ ከእርከኑ በታች፣ ከታች ጀምሮ እስከ መካከሉ ድረስ ሠራለት።
am.B: ለመሠዊያው እንደ መረብ የተሠራ የነሐስ ፍርግርግ ሠራ፤ ከእርከኑ በታች አድርጎ ከታች ጀምሮ እስከ መሠዊያው መካከል ድረስ እንዲደርስ አደረገው።
am.R: ለመሠዊያው መረብ የሚመስል የነሐስ ፍርግርግ ሠራ። ፍርግርጉ በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ካለው እርከን በታች ነበረ፤ እስከ መሠዊያው ግማሽ ቁመት ድረስ ይደርስ ነበር።

decisions.choice: a grating, a work of network: a bronze lattice on the lower half of the altar
decisions.reason: This is the grating of 27:4-5. Whether it was inside the altar or around the outside of its lower half is not said (see the note at 27:4).

decisions.choice: its ledge: a rim or band around the altar, halfway up
decisions.reason: The word is found only here and in 27:5, and its meaning is not certain. It seems to have been a ledge or band around the sides of the altar, with the grating below it.

decisions.choice: set it (Balanced); It was (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew joins the place of the grating straight onto the verb "made". Balanced and Readable add a verb to say where it went.

decisions.choice: "wavu" (grating); "ukingo" (ledge)
decisions.reason: The grating is "a work of network" (m1), so "wavu" (a net, a mesh) names it as the Hebrew does. The ledge is uncertain (m2); "ukingo", a raised edge running round the altar, is the word used for it in 27:5, and "ukanda" is kept for the woven band of the ephod.

decisions.choice: "석쇠" for the grating and "턱" for its ledge
decisions.reason: "석쇠" names a metal lattice; "그물" alone would suggest cord. "턱" is a projecting rim, which is what the ledge around the altar was; Readable adds that it ran around the altar.

decisions.choice: "gờ" for the ledge
decisions.reason: "gờ" is a band or rim standing out from a surface, the sense the meaning decision gives; "viền" would suggest the top edge.

decisions.choice: "ፍርግርግ" for the grating, "እርከን" for the ledge
decisions.reason: "ፍርግርግ" is a metal lattice; "መረብ" (net) is kept for the pattern it was worked in. "እርከን" is a step or ledge running round the altar.

source.text: וַיִּצֹ֞ק אַרְבַּ֧ע טַבָּעֹ֛ת בְּאַרְבַּ֥ע הַקְּצָוֺ֖ת לְמִכְבַּ֣ר הַנְּחֹ֑שֶׁת בָּתִּ֖ים לַבַּדִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he cast four rings on the four ends of the grating of the bronze, holders for the poles.

en.L: And he cast four rings at the four ends of the bronze grating, holders for the poles.
en.B: He cast four rings for the four corners of the bronze grating, to hold the poles.
en.R: He made four rings out of melted bronze and put them on the four corners of the grate. The rings held the carrying poles.

es.L: Y fundió cuatro anillos en los cuatro extremos del enrejado de bronce, alojamiento para las barras.
es.B: Fundió cuatro anillos para las cuatro esquinas del enrejado de bronce, para alojar las barras.
es.R: Hizo cuatro anillos de bronce fundido y los puso en las cuatro esquinas de la parrilla. Los anillos sostenían las barras para transportarlo.

fr.L: Et il fondit quatre anneaux aux quatre extrémités de la grille de bronze, logements pour les barres.
fr.B: Il fondit quatre anneaux pour les quatre coins de la grille de bronze, afin de recevoir les barres.
fr.R: Il a fait quatre anneaux en bronze fondu et les a mis aux quatre coins de la grille. Les anneaux tenaient les barres de transport.

sw.L: Akasubu pete nne kwenye ncha nne za wavu wa shaba, vishikio vya mipiko.
sw.B: Akasubu pete nne kwa ajili ya kona nne za wavu wa shaba, ili kushika mipiko.
sw.R: Akatengeneza pete nne kwa shaba iliyoyeyushwa, akaziweka kwenye kona nne za wavu. Pete hizo zilishika mipiko ya kubebea.

vi.L: Và ông đúc bốn khoen ở bốn đầu của tấm rá bằng đồng, [làm] chỗ xỏ cho các đòn.
vi.B: Ông đúc bốn khoen cho bốn góc tấm rá bằng đồng để xỏ đòn.
vi.R: Ông nấu chảy đồng để làm bốn cái khoen và gắn vào bốn góc tấm rá. Các khoen ấy dùng để giữ đòn khiêng.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 고리 넷을 부어 만들어 놋 석쇠의 네 끝에 [달았으니], 채들을 끼울 자리였다.
ko.B: 그는 고리 네 개를 부어 만들어 놋 석쇠의 네 모퉁이에 달고, 채를 끼우는 데 쓰게 했다.
ko.R: 그는 놋을 녹여 틀에 부어서 고리 네 개를 만들고, 석쇠의 네 모퉁이에 달았다. 그 고리들은 제단을 메는 채를 끼우는 데 썼다.

pt.L: E fundiu quatro argolas nas quatro extremidades da grelha de bronze, suportes para as varas.
pt.B: Fundiu quatro argolas para os quatro cantos da grelha de bronze, para segurar as varas.
pt.R: Ele derramou bronze derretido em moldes e fez quatro argolas. Pôs as argolas nos quatro cantos da grelha. Elas seguravam as varas usadas para carregar o altar.

am.L: ለነሐሱም ፍርግርግ በአራቱ ጫፎች ለመሎጊያዎቹ ማስገቢያ የሚሆኑ አራት ቀለበቶችን አቅልጦ ሠራ።
am.B: ለነሐሱ ፍርግርግ ለአራቱ ማዕዘኖች መሎጊያዎቹን የሚይዙ አራት ቀለበቶችን አቅልጦ ሠራ።
am.R: ከቀለጠ ነሐስ አራት ቀለበቶች ሠርቶ በፍርግርጉ አራት ማዕዘኖች ላይ አደረጋቸው። ቀለበቶቹ የመሸከሚያ መሎጊያዎቹን ይይዙ ነበር።

decisions.choice: cast: made by pouring molten metal into a mold
decisions.reason: The verb means to pour. The rings were cast in molds, as the bases of 26:37 were.

decisions.choice: holders: literally "houses" for the poles
decisions.reason: The rings were places for the poles to pass through, so that the altar could be carried (27:4, 7).

decisions.choice: made out of melted bronze
decisions.reason: Readable explains "cast", as at 26:37.

decisions.choice: "채" for the carrying poles; Literal "끼울 자리" for the "houses" that held them
decisions.reason: "채" is the ordinary word for the poles a load is carried by. Literal keeps the picture of a place made for the poles without the odd "집".

decisions.choice: "khoen" for the rings, "đòn" (L, B) / "đòn khiêng" (R) for the poles
decisions.reason: "khoen" is a metal ring fixed to an object to hold something; "đòn" is already a carrying pole in Vietnamese, so "khiêng" is added only at Readable, as the English Readable adds "carrying".

source.text: וַיַּ֥עַשׂ אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וַיְצַ֥ף אֹתָ֖ם נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made the poles [of] woods of acacia and overlaid them [with] bronze.

en.L: And he made the poles [of] acacia wood and overlaid them [with] bronze.
en.B: He made the poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.
en.R: He made the carrying poles out of acacia wood and covered them with bronze.

es.L: E hizo las barras [de] madera de acacia y las revistió [de] bronce.
es.B: Hizo las barras de madera de acacia y las revistió de bronce.
es.R: Hizo de madera de acacia las barras para transportarlo, y las cubrió de bronce.

fr.L: Et il fit les barres [de] bois d’acacia et les plaqua [de] bronze.
fr.B: Il fit les barres en bois d’acacia et les plaqua de bronze.
fr.R: Il a fait les barres de transport en bois d’acacia et les a recouvertes de bronze.

sw.L: Akaifanya mipiko [kwa] mbao za mshita, akaifunika [kwa] shaba.
sw.B: Akaitengeneza mipiko kwa mbao za mshita, akaifunika kwa shaba.
sw.R: Akatengeneza mipiko ya kubebea kwa mbao za mshita, akaifunika kwa shaba.

vi.L: Và ông làm các đòn [bằng] gỗ keo và bọc chúng [bằng] đồng.
vi.B: Ông làm các đòn bằng gỗ keo rồi bọc đồng.
vi.R: Ông làm các đòn khiêng bằng gỗ keo và bọc chúng bằng đồng.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 채들을 아카시아 나무로 만들고 그것들을 놋으로 입혔다.
ko.B: 그는 아카시아 나무로 채를 만들고 놋으로 입혔다.
ko.R: 그는 아카시아 나무로 제단을 멜 채를 만들고 놋으로 씌웠다.

pt.L: E fez as varas [de] madeira de acácia e as cobriu [de] bronze.
pt.B: Fez as varas de madeira de acácia e as revestiu de bronze.
pt.R: Ele fez de madeira de acácia as varas para carregar o altar e as cobriu de bronze.

am.L: መሎጊያዎቹንም ከግራር እንጨት ሠራ፤ በነሐስም ለበጣቸው።
am.B: መሎጊያዎቹን ከግራር እንጨት ሠርቶ በነሐስ ለበጣቸው።
am.R: የመሸከሚያ መሎጊያዎቹን ከግራር እንጨት ሠርቶ በነሐስ ሸፈናቸው።

decisions.choice: poles: carrying poles
decisions.reason: As in 27:6, the poles were for carrying the altar when the camp moved (Numbers 4:13-14).

decisions.choice: carrying poles
decisions.reason: Readable says what the poles were for.

source.text: וַיָּבֵ֨א אֶת־הַבַּדִּ֜ים בַּטַּבָּעֹ֗ת עַ֚ל צַלְעֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֶ֑ם נְב֥וּב לֻחֹ֖ת עָשָׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, to carry it by them; hollow [of] boards he made it.

en.L: And he put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, to carry it with them; hollow, [of] boards he made it.
en.B: He slid the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar for carrying it. He built the altar as a hollow box of planks.
en.R: He slid the poles through the rings on the sides of the altar, so it could be carried. He made the altar like a hollow box out of boards.

es.L: Y metió las barras en los anillos sobre los costados del altar, para llevarlo con ellas; hueco, [de] tablas lo hizo.
es.B: Pasó las barras por los anillos de los costados del altar para llevarlo. Construyó el altar como un cajón hueco de tablas.
es.R: Pasó las barras por los anillos de los costados del altar, para poder llevarlo. Hizo el altar como una caja hueca de tablas.

fr.L: Et il fit entrer les barres dans les anneaux sur les côtés de l’autel, pour le porter avec elles ; creux, [en] planches, il le fit.
fr.B: Il passa les barres dans les anneaux sur les côtés de l’autel, pour le porter. Il construisit l’autel comme un coffre creux en planches.
fr.R: Il a passé les barres dans les anneaux, sur les côtés de l’autel, pour qu’on puisse le porter. Il a fait l’autel comme une caisse creuse en planches.

sw.L: Akaiingiza mipiko katika pete zilizo pande za madhabahu, ili kuibeba kwayo; yenye uvungu, [ya] mbao aliifanya.
sw.B: Akaipitisha mipiko katika pete zilizo pande za madhabahu, kwa ajili ya kuibeba. Aliijenga madhabahu kama sanduku la mbao lenye uvungu.
sw.R: Akapitisha mipiko katika pete zilizo pande za madhabahu, ili iweze kubebwa. Aliifanya madhabahu kama sanduku la mbao lililo wazi ndani.

vi.L: Và ông xỏ các đòn vào các khoen ở hai bên bàn thờ, để khiêng nó bằng chúng; ông làm nó rỗng, [bằng] ván.
vi.B: Ông xỏ các đòn vào các khoen ở hai bên bàn thờ để khiêng bàn thờ. Ông đóng bàn thờ bằng ván, bên trong để rỗng.
vi.R: Ông xỏ các đòn khiêng vào các khoen ở hai bên bàn thờ để có thể khiêng nó đi. Ông đóng bàn thờ bằng ván, giống như một cái hộp rỗng.

ko.L: 그리고 그는 채들을 제단의 옆면들에 있는 고리들에 끼워, 그것들로 그것을 메게 했다. 판자들로 속이 비게 그는 그것을 만들었다.
ko.B: 그는 제단 양옆에 있는 고리에 채를 끼워 제단을 멜 수 있게 했다. 제단은 널빤지로 속이 비게 짠 상자 모양으로 만들었다.
ko.R: 그는 제단 양옆의 고리에 채를 끼워서 제단을 옮길 수 있게 했다. 제단은 널빤지로 만든 속이 빈 상자 같았다.

pt.L: E introduziu as varas nas argolas, nos lados do altar, para levá-lo com elas; oco, [de] tábuas o fez.
pt.B: Passou as varas pelas argolas dos lados do altar, para que ele fosse carregado com elas. Fez o altar como uma caixa oca, de tábuas.
pt.R: Ele passou as varas pelas argolas dos lados do altar, para que o altar pudesse ser carregado. Fez o altar como uma caixa oca de tábuas.

am.L: መሎጊያዎቹንም በእነርሱ ለመሸከም በመሠዊያው ጎኖች ባሉት ቀለበቶች ውስጥ አስገባ፤ ከጣውላዎች ባዶ አድርጎ ሠራው።
am.B: መሠዊያውን ለመሸከም መሎጊያዎቹን በጎኖቹ ባሉት ቀለበቶች ውስጥ አሾለካቸው። መሠዊያውንም ከጣውላዎች ውስጡ ባዶ የሆነ ሣጥን አድርጎ ሠራው።
am.R: መሠዊያውን መሸከም እንዲቻል መሎጊያዎቹን በጎኖቹ ባሉት ቀለበቶች ውስጥ አሾለካቸው። መሠዊያውን ከጣውላዎች ውስጡ ባዶ እንደሆነ ሣጥን አድርጎ ሠራው።

decisions.choice: hollow, of boards: a hollow frame of planks
decisions.reason: As in 27:8, the altar was a box of acacia planks covered with bronze. Whether it was filled with earth or stones where it stood is not said (see the note at 27:8).

decisions.choice: "ጣውላዎች" for the boards of the altar
alternatives: "ሳንቃዎች" (kept for the frames of the tabernacle)
decisions.reason: The tabernacle's frames are a different Hebrew word (39:33; 40:18), given as "ሳንቃዎች".

source.text: וַיַּ֗עַשׂ אֵ֚ת הַכִּיּ֣וֹר נְחֹ֔שֶׁת וְאֵ֖ת כַּנּ֣וֹ נְחֹ֑שֶׁת בְּמַרְאֹת֙ הַצֹּ֣בְאֹ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֣ר צָֽבְא֔וּ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And he made the basin [of] bronze and its stand [of] bronze, with the mirrors of the serving [women] who served [at] the entrance of the tent of meeting.

en.L: And he made the basin [of] bronze and its stand [of] bronze, from the mirrors of the serving women who served [at] the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.B: He made the basin and its stand of bronze. The bronze came from the mirrors of the women who served at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
en.R: He made the basin, a large bronze bowl, and its bronze stand. He made them from the bronze mirrors of the women who served at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
